thesis: The page is the layout string of one Boise backyard fence: pulled tight at the hero, every section is a post the string sets, and you build the fence by scrolling.

signature.name: Mason's String + Post Stations
signature.summary: A taut 2px cedar-orange layout string runs the whole page with square post marks every 8 ft and stake tags (mono) as section labels; a fixed 'ft built' counter climbs with scroll. Hero: snaps tight between two corner stakes. Process: each step drops a post. Post-depth: the string turns vertical as the plumb line. Services/reviews hang from posts. Estimator: the user's feet draw a live string with the real post count. Footer: ends at Stake B with the final count.

palette.family: Boise Sagebrush + Cedar String + Pine Ink

layoutMoves: page-long string in a left margin column with posts as section anchors
drawn etched-line plates instead of stock photos
vertical plumb-line cross-section breaking the horizontal flow
live estimator string with real post count

motion.intro: string snaps tight Stake A to B with 2% overshoot (600ms) and the first post drops; h1 line-mask rises; text visible from frame 0
stories: stack: posts drop onto the string and the ft counter counts 0 to 48 across the 7 process steps
draw: post-depth cross-section draws grade to frost line with the depth dimension
motion.hover: pluck: element lifts 2px and its string segment vibrates one cycle
